blocks.text: Cryptocurrencies aur smart contracts ne digital finance (paison ka len den) aur decentralized applications mein bari tabdeeliyan ki hain. Cryptocurrencies aisi digital currencies (raqam) hain jo traditional (purane aam) bankon ke baghair chalti hain aur duniya bhar mein logon ke darmiyan seedhi transactions mumkin banati hain. Smart contracts code mein likhe hue automatic agreements (samjhaute) hain jo kuch khaas conditions (shartein) poori hone par khud chal jate hain. Yeh dono technologies mil kar paison ke len den aur agreements ko mehfooz, transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) aur efficient tareeqe se sambhalti hain.

blocks.prompt: Smart contract ko 'smart' kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke conditions poori hote hi woh apni shartein khud execute (laagu) kar deta hai; kisi insaan ya intermediary ko kuch karna nahi parta.

items: Cryptocurrencies: bankon ke baghair digital raqam.
Smart contracts: code mein likhe agreements jo conditions poori hone par khud chalte hain.
